evidence.name: AISpeedDeltaSetter

function_ir.summary: Sets an AI speed-delta flag: when the input a2 is 0 or 1, writes a2 to the dword at this+0x4550; when a2 equals 1, additionally triggers an AI state transition via sub_4A46F0(this, 1, 0). Returns a2 unchanged in all other cases.

operations.description: Seed result with a2 (the default return value).
Guard on a2 <= 1; write the speed-delta flag this[0x4550] = a2 only for the allowed 0/1 values.
Guard on a2 == 1; when the speed-delta flag is being activated, call sub_4A46F0(this, 1, 0) to trigger the AI state transition and return its result.
Return result (a2, or the sub_4A46F0 result when a2 == 1).
